rules.title: San Francisco allowable annual rent increase, March 1, 2026 - February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: The allowable rent increase published by the SF Rent Board for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.citation: SF Rent Board, Current Rates (sf.gov report page), Allowable Rent Increase
rules.interaction: The chunk does not state which units are covered or any exemptions. The coverage predicate is a conservative placeholder that depends on the city_rent_controlled fact and needs reviewer confirmation.

rules.title: San Francisco security deposit interest rate, March 1, 2026 - February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: The security deposit interest rate published by the SF Rent Board for the period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 4.2%.
rules.citation: SF Rent Board, Current Rates (sf.gov report page), Security Deposit Interest
rules.interaction: The chunk gives only the rate. It does not state who owes the interest, the payment mechanics, or which tenancies are covered. The coverage predicate is a placeholder for review.

rules.title: San Francisco relocation payments for owner/relative move-in, demolition/removal, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation evictions (notices served 3/01/26 - 2/28/27)
rules.requirement: For evictions based on owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit from housing use, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation, where the eviction notice is served 3/01/26 - 2/28/27, the relocation amount is $8,245.00 per tenant, up to $24,733.00 per unit. An additional $5,497.00 is due for each elderly (60 or older) or disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren).
rules.citation: SF Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C (as referenced on SF Rent Board Current Rates page)
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; $24,733.00 max per unit; +$5,497.00 per elderly/disabled tenant or household with minor child(ren)
rules.interaction: Temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days are governed by Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Section 37.9C, per the source note. See the separate temporary displacement rule.

rules.title: San Francisco relocation payments for Ellis Act evictions (notices served 3/01/26 - 2/28/27)
rules.requirement: For tenants evicted under the Ellis Act, where the eviction notice is served 3/01/26 - 2/28/27, the relocation amount is $11,110.05 per tenant, up to $33,330.13 per unit. An additional $7,443.90 is due for each elderly (62 or older) or disabled tenant.
rules.citation: SF Rent Ordinance Section 37.9A (as referenced on SF Rent Board Current Rates page)
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; $33,330.13 max per unit; +$7,443.90 per elderly/disabled tenant

rules.title: San Francisco relocation payment for temporary displacement of less than 20 days (notices served 3/01/26 - 2/28/27)
rules.requirement: For temporary displacement of less than 20 days, where the eviction notice is served 3/01/26 - 2/28/27, the relocation amount per tenant household is $446.00 per day plus actual moving expenses.
rules.citation: California Civil Code Section 1947.9 (as referenced on SF Rent Board Current Rates page)
rules.interaction: The source note says relocation for temporary capital improvement evictions of less than 20 days is governed by Civil Code 1947.9 and not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
